_doc: Ariadne's overlay on the Hermes desktop app. Applied to a throwaway copy of upstream at the pinned commit; upstream/ is never touched. Every edit states how many matches it expects; if a Hermes bump moves one, the build stops and names it. Keep this cosmetic plus the local-only lock: never rename HERMES_* env vars, config keys, folders or protocol.
name: Ariadne

edits.why: product name, data folder and appId: Ariadne never shares state with a stock Hermes install
keep the executable file Hermes.exe so Hermes' own build pipeline still finds and verifies the pack
the app's own name in UI copy (Hermes the engine keeps its name)
local-only lock: if Ariadne's runtime is not usable, fail with a clear error instead of falling through to the installer or a remote gateway
